newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens in German cartel watchdog probe.
newsitem.headline: Siemens in German cartel watchdog probe.

text.p: German electronics giant Siemens AG is one of a number of cable producers being investigated by the German cartel office on suspicion of building a quota cartel, which is a scheme to restrict a commodity.
The German newspaper Boersenzeitung said in its weekend edition that the cartel office was investigating Siemens, two units of Alcatel and other companies.
A spokesman for Siemens told Reuters that the cartel watchdog was investigating the group, but was unable to add anything to that as he said the investigation was ongoing.
Boersenzeitung said the investigation related to the supply of heavy power cable.
